classification.difficultyReason: Read the centre and spread from two frequency histograms (P concentrated at 6, Q symmetric about 7 and more spread out), then justify. Mostly qualitative, with a little interpretation.

content.prompt: Two classes sat the same quiz, marked out of 10. The graphs show the marks of each class.

children.label: a
children.prompt: Which class has the higher mean?

answer.worked: Class P's marks are balanced around 6 and Class Q's marks are balanced around 7, so Class Q has the higher mean.

children.label: b
children.prompt: Which class has the larger standard deviation? Give a reason.

answer.short: Class Q, because its marks are spread over a wider range.
answer.worked: Class P's marks are all between 5 and 7, mostly close to the mean. Class Q's marks range from 4 to 10, with many far from the mean. Class Q has more spread, so it has the larger standard deviation.
